user_query: I'm organizing a company event and I want to send out email invitations to all employees. Before sending them, I need to validate their email addresses to ensure successful delivery.

TaskList.description: Collect a list of all employee email addresses for the invitation.
Validate the collected email addresses to ensure they are valid and not disposable.
Retrieve the MX (Mail Exchange) records for the validated email addresses to ensure proper email delivery.
Send out email invitations to the validated and confirmed email addresses.
